subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: What failure details are safe to surface in normal chat, and when should OpenClaw replace a failed-tool warning with a same-action recovered/succeeded status?
rationale: Current code deliberately hides most raw details outside trusted verbose cases, while the requested retry confirmation affects mutating side effects and external-recipient channels; automation should not choose that security boundary.

options.title: Sanitized Recovery Status
options.body: Show a scrubbed failure class or safe receipt plus a same-action recovered confirmation, keeping raw commands and paths in verbose or diagnostics-only surfaces.

options.title: Keep Details Hidden
options.body: Preserve the current normal-mode detail boundary and address only narrower ordering or suppression bugs in the linked issues.

options.title: Trusted-Channel Details
options.body: Expose richer reasons only for explicitly trusted operator channels or admin modes, accepting a larger configuration and audit surface.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Recovery Status
recommendation.body: Show a scrubbed failure class or safe receipt plus a same-action recovered confirmation, keeping raw commands and paths in verbose or diagnostics-only surfaces.
